Definition: properly, to be (or make) bare; but used only in the derivative sense (through the idea perhaps of smoothness) to be cunning (usually in a bad sense)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to be subtle, be shrewd, be crafty, beware, take crafty counsel, be prudent; 1a) (Qal) to be crafty, be subtle; 1b) (Hiphil) to be crafty, be or become shrewd
